title: worldmonitor
brief: An open-source (AGPL-3.0) real-time global intelligence dashboard: AI-synthesized news briefs, a 3D globe and WebGL flat map, a live Country Instability Index for 31 Tier-1 countries, and cross-stream correlation of military, economic, and disaster signals. It is built for programmatic access too — MCP server, REST API with OpenAPI spec, CLI (`npx worldmonitor`), and Python/Ruby/Go SDKs, with local-AI support via Ollama — and ships as a web app, Tauri desktop binaries, and PWA. AGPL-3.0 copyleft applies, so commercial/SaaS use needs a separate license or AGPL compliance.
details: World Monitor (koala73/worldmonitor, AGPL-3.0) is a real-time global intelligence dashboard combining AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in one situational-awareness interface. It offers curated news feeds AI-synthesized into briefs, a dual map engine (3D globe via globe.gl and a WebGL flat map via deck.gl sharing one layer catalog), cross-stream correlation across military, economic, disaster, and escalation signals, a live Country Instability Index v8 scoring 31 Tier-1 countries, a finance radar (stocks, commodities, crypto, market composite), and the option to run everything locally with Ollama and no API keys. One codebase ships six site variants (world, tech, finance, commodity, happy, energy), a Tauri 2 desktop app for macOS/Windows/Linux, and a multilingual UI with native-language feeds and RTL support. It is built for programmatic use too: an MCP server, REST API with OpenAPI spec, an official CLI (npx worldmonitor), zero-dependency SDKs for Python, Ruby, and Go, plus llms.txt and an agent-skills manifest. The stack is vanilla TypeScript, Vite, Three.js, and MapLibre GL, self-hostable via Vercel, Docker, or static export.
